blocks.content:
The Central Vigilance Commissioner and Vigilance Commissioners are appointed by the President on the recommendation of a committee consisting of:
• Prime Minister – Chairperson
• Home Minister
• Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha
The Central Vigilance Commissioner and Vigilance Commissioners are appointed by the President on the recommendation of a committee

items: Note that the appointment is made by the President, but mandatory recommendation comes from a specific 3-member committee.
Remember the three composition members of the recommendation committee: Prime Minister (Chairperson), Home Minister, and Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Central Vigilance Commissioner and Vigilance Commissioners are appointed by the President.
Appointments are based on the recommendations of a three-member selection committee.
The Prime Minister serves as the Chairperson of the recommendation committee.
The Home Minister and the Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha are key members of the committee.
